conflicts.about: features → arm-cutout → profile, plane, and axis
conflicts.evidence: The lower-centre view on page 1 supplies the length-and-depth profile and its 30 mm dimension; VIEW B is the height-direction section through that same cutout.
conflicts.stands: The arm cutout profile lies in the plane of the length and the depth and extends through the part parallel to the height. In the lower-centre view on page 1, its rounded left end has vertical straight extent between the depth stations 40.86 and 52.34 mm, rounded into the profile walls by approximately R4.3 corners; its upper and lower walls are at depth stations 55.89 and 37.31 mm and run to the ring-axis station at approximately 90.49 mm. The printed 30 mm dimension runs from the cutout's left-end station at x=60.71 mm to the ring axis at x=90.73 mm.
conflicts.was_also_said: a tapered through cutout in the plane of the length and the height, through the part depth front to rear

conflicts.about: features → ring-split → width and heightwise position
conflicts.evidence: The page-1 middle-centre view dimensions the upper split face from the ring axis as 1 mm and the lower split face from the ring axis as 2 mm.
conflicts.stands: The ring split is 3 mm wide between its two faces. Its upper split face is 1 mm above the ring axis and its lower split face is 2 mm below the ring axis; therefore the split centre plane is 0.5 mm below the ring axis, not centred on it.
conflicts.was_also_said: the ring split is centred on the ring axis

conflicts.evidence: Page 2 directs that the red-cloud revisions replace the Phase 1 geometry; VIEW C-C replaces the left lug and horizontal arm with the angled arm. No Phase-2 overall dimension to the angled free-end face is printed.
conflicts.stands: The finished Phase 2 model does not retain the Phase 1 108 mm envelope, because its left-hand measurement face was the leftmost tangent plane of the replaced left lug. Page 2 supplies no replacement overall length between the angled-arm free end and the rightmost end face.
conflicts.was_also_said: 108 mm remains the finished-part length between the leftmost tangent plane of the left lug and the rightmost end face
